definition: Stable identity, source ancestry, provenance, aliases/supersession and no unresolved identity conflict.
Correct current taxonomy/domain routing with controlled values and explicit unresolved state.
Required name/description/use/context metadata is sufficient for GM/player comprehension; unknowns are explicit.
Intrinsic requirements, affinity/context, availability/legality distinctions and compatibility semantics are valid where applicable.
Required parentage, compatibility, ammunition/power/component/product/creator/lineage links are canonical or explicitly unresolved.
Current-rule mechanics/effects/resources/limits are complete enough for the record role and pass domain checks.
Applicable runtime operations are bound to A8/F014/etc. without duplicating definition/instance state.
Schema, reference, provenance, permission, save/load/offline/pack and domain regressions pass as applicable.
Representative or focused playtest evidence exists for novel/high-risk mechanics; routine records may inherit validated cohort evidence.
